guide.title: Guide
guide.heroKicker: A short guide for Arasya admins
guide.heroTitle: How the day works: website, dashboard and driver app
guide.heroSubtitle: Bookings come in from the website form or are created by an admin, are scheduled per day in the dashboard, are carried out by drivers in the app, and are billed and closed in the dashboard. WhatsApp is still used, by hand: the dashboard opens WhatsApp with the message already filled in, and you press send.

menuGroups.d: {menuDashboard}: revenue, margin, cash and the Needs attention list (overdue receivables and payables). {menuNotifications}: updates from the driver app and e-toll top-up requests.
{menuLeads}, {menuOrders}, {menuCustomers} and {menuPriceList}: from the customer request to a confirmed order.
{menuInvoices} (billing customers), {menuPayables} (driver fees and vendor costs) and {menuRevenue} (reports per unit, vendor and driver).

steps: Check {menuLeads} (the New tab) and {menuNotifications} several times a day.
When a lead books: click Create order, fill in the phone number, price and unit, then save. Bookings by phone or chat are created in {menuOrders} → Create Order.
On the order page, create a Rental Invoice of type Down Payment (DP) of at least 20% of the rental and send it to the customer with Send.
Once the money reaches the office BCA account, click Mark Paid and upload the transfer proof.
Assign a driver and car per day: Edit on the row in {menuTrip}, or Assign on that day on the order page. Check the Availability Timeline first to avoid clashes.
Send the confirmation from the Confirmation column in {menuTrip} (Send to Customer).
Bill the rest with Settlement (Remaining Balance); it is due on the first service day. The trip with the customer can only start once the order is paid in full.
While the trip runs, follow the driver progress and the proof of arrival on the order page, and approve or reject the trip costs sent by the driver.
When every day is done, the order moves to Needs Finalization. Check the driver fees and costs, then click Finalize Order.
Pay driver fees and vendor costs in {menuPayables}.

leadsItems.d: The booking form on the website creates a lead with an ARS-XXXXX code. The same code is in the WhatsApp message the customer sends to the admin, so chat and lead are easy to match.
Click Create order: the trip details are already filled in. Add the customer phone number, price and unit, then save. The order code is the lead code, all the way to the invoice.

leadsItems.t: Order already made from the chat
leadsItems.d: Use Link to order to avoid a duplicate. Spam, duplicates or price questions only: Ignore and pick the reason.
Partner needed only means the requested unit is not in the Arasya fleet. You may still use your own unit and driver, including for trips out of town.

{menuOrders} → Create Order. Look up a returning customer by name or phone number (click Use this data when recognised), choose Order Fulfilled By, then add one service row per day: date, time, pickup, destination and price.
Edit Order changes dates, times, places, prices or contacts. When the price changes a reason is required. Invoices do not change automatically, so revise or add an invoice afterwards.

guide.tripsIntro: Assignments are made per day, not per order. A multi-day order may use a different driver or car on each day.

tripsItems.d: In {menuTrip} → the Schedule tab, the weekly timeline shows who is free and who already has a trip (switch between Drivers and Cars). Click a date to see the free drivers and cars and assign straight away.

Below the timeline is a list with one row per day per order (Today, Tomorrow, This week, All). Edit opens Edit Day: driver and car, status, driver fee, travel advance, or the vendor for that day. Save with Save & Recompute.
An internal driver can only be chosen once the DP or the settlement is recorded (invoice marked paid). Until then the day shows Awaiting DP. Cars and partner days can still be set.

Confirmation column → Send to Customer opens WhatsApp with the confirmation message. Afterwards the links Also send to driver (WhatsApp) and, when the driver changed, Notify previous driver appear. Internal drivers also get the job in the app.
When the time or driver of a day changes, its confirmation becomes Changed, needs resend. Click Send Changes so the customer and driver know.

tripsItems.t: Change the driver for all days
tripsItems.d: On the order page, Reassign All overwrites the driver and car on every day that has not started. Days in progress, done or cancelled are left alone.

The Not closed chip lists trips from before yesterday that are still open; they no longer appear in the driver app. Click Edit, set the status to Done if the trip took place or Cancelled if it did not, then save.
The History tab holds finished trips: the trip timeline, driver reports and photos, the proof of arrival and the driver fee.

invoiceItems.d: On the order page: Rental Invoice → Down Payment (DP). At least 20% of the rental; the customer may pay more. The order becomes DP Paid only when the money actually received is at least 20% of the rental.
Rental Invoice → Settlement (Remaining Balance), due on the first service day. If the customer pays everything at once, choose Full Payment.

Overtime, parking, extra stops and the like: click Add Additional on the order page first (the order total goes up), then bill it with an Additional Invoice. If there is no invoice yet, a Combined Invoice (Rental + Additional) bills both at once.

Once the money is in, click Mark Paid and upload the Payment Proof (required; for cash, a photo taken when the money is received). Leave Amount Received empty when it equals the invoice amount. A paid invoice becomes a Receipt (kwitansi).

Send and Send Kwitansi on the order page, or Send PDF via WhatsApp and Send Kwitansi via WhatsApp in {menuInvoices}, open WhatsApp with the message filled in; press send in WhatsApp. Invoices in Draft, Revised or Cancelled status cannot be sent.
Wrong amount, or the order price changed: click Revise on the active invoice. The old invoice stays as history.

Cancel Order calculates the cancellation fee according to the policy and issues a cancellation invoice only for the part not yet paid. If the customer paid more, return the difference and record it with Mark Refund and the transfer proof.

guide.driverAppIntro: The driver app is for internal Arasya drivers only. Partner drivers do not use the app.

driverAppItems.d: Drivers log in to the app with their phone number and a password set by the admin: {menuDrivers} → driver detail → Set password. Every driver needs a different phone number.
The order page shows the driver steps per day: Accepted by driver, Departed, Arrived at pickup, Customer on board and Finished. Until the driver accepts, it shows Not yet accepted by driver.

driverAppItems.t: Start trip only when paid in full
driverAppItems.d: The driver may depart and mark the arrival at pickup before the order is paid in full, but “Start trip” (customer on board) in the app unlocks only once the settlement is recorded. Such days are marked Not paid in full.

The driver takes a photo with the GPS camera on arrival. The order page and the History tab show the photo, coordinates, View on map and Route to pickup address to check the distance between driver and address. Watch for Fake location detected or No photo/GPS.

Fuel, toll, parking and other receipts from the driver appear under Trip costs for that day with the status Waiting for review. Click Approve or Reject (the reason is sent to the driver). Choose Paid by the office when it was paid with an office e-toll or card, and tick Bill to customer (Additional Invoice) when the customer bears it. An order cannot be finalized while costs are still waiting for review.

The bell at the top and the {menuNotifications} menu show updates from the app: job accepted, departed, arrived, customer on board, finished, reports and new costs (Needs review). Click one to open the related page.

Top-up requests from drivers appear in {menuNotifications} → Driver requests. Top up the card through m-banking, then click Mark as topped up, choose the Card topped up and enter the Top-up amount. The driver is notified and needs to tap the card to update the balance before entering the toll road.

Register every card in {menuEtoll} with Add card, including the full number for top-ups. Drivers record taking and returning a card in the app; admins can also use Hand to a driver, Mark as returned, Record top-up, Record balance and Record toll. The balance in the dashboard is an estimate; the real balance is on the card chip.

customersItems.d: Customers are recorded automatically when an order is created. Returning customers are recognised by their phone number in the order form.

NIK, address, company and KTP/SIM/NPWP documents are kept on the customer detail page (Identity & documents). The customer list only shows a masked NIK; the full NIK is only on the detail page. After checking the identity, click Mark as verified.
The customer detail page shows the order history, tags (e.g. VIP, Corporate) and loyalty notes.

partnersItems.d: {menuVendors} keeps vendors with their cars, contact person, service area and bank account. New vendors and cars can also be created straight from Edit Day.

In Edit Day choose External, then the vendor, vendor car and RTR (vendor cost, this day). Fill in Partner driver & unit (name, phone number, plate) so the WhatsApp confirmation is complete; until then the Confirmation column shows Complete the partner driver & plate.
Partner days are run from the dashboard and closed with Edit → status Done. Partner days are not subject to the DP requirement.

financeItems.d: Every invoice and receipt across all orders: search, view the PDF and send it by WhatsApp.

Driver Payables (fee + approved reimbursements − travel advance) and Vendor Payables. Click Pay, or select several and click Pay Selected; the driver is notified that the fee has been paid. Fees and travel advances are changed in Edit Day; once paid, click Mark unpaid first.

Revenue = day prices + additional charges (counted on the date recorded) + cancellation fees (on the cancellation date). Trip costs re-billed to the customer are not revenue. Partner days count at the price charged to the customer; the RTR is a cost.

Official prices per city. Changes appear on the website only after Publish to website; until then the website uses the old prices. Prices marked as proposed need the owner to confirm them before publishing.

rules.d: Payments go only to BCA 0954840782 in the name of PT Ayomi Raya Karsa. Never give a personal account to a customer.

Before the travel day: 20% of the order total. On the travel day until 10:00 WIB and the trip has not started: 50%. After that: 100%. Cancel an order with Cancel Order; an order whose days are all done is closed with Finalize Order, not cancelled.
An internal driver can only be assigned after the DP or the settlement is marked paid. The trip with the customer can only start once the order is paid in full.
NIK and KTP documents are confidential (UU PDP) and only used to verify bookings. Documents open through View with a temporary link; delete them if the customer asks.

A day that already has a driver cannot be removed in Edit Order; cancel it in Edit Day. The last active day cannot be cancelled in Edit Day; use Cancel Order. Edit Day also refuses a change that would bring the order total below the invoices already issued; revise the invoice first.
Days on a Done or Cancelled order are locked. Billing (invoices, payments, receipts, refunds) is still possible.

mistakes: Marking an invoice paid before the money has actually reached the office BCA account.
Trying to choose a driver before the DP is recorded. Create the DP invoice, wait for the transfer, then Mark Paid with the proof.
Forgetting to press send in WhatsApp. The dashboard buttons only open WhatsApp with the message filled in.
Not resending the confirmation after the time or driver changed (status Changed, needs resend).
Logging overtime or parking without Add Additional, so the Additional Invoice has nothing left to bill.
Leaving trip costs in Waiting for review, so the order cannot be finalized.
Leaving old trips open. Check the Not closed chip in {menuTrip} regularly.

orderDetail.finalizeAdditionalWarning: This order has additional charges. Before finalizing, double-check the additional items, ops cost, and driver fee are all correct — finalizing closes the order.

orderDetail.cancelRefundHint: The customer overpaid versus the cancellation fee. Process the refund via the Mark Refund flow.
orderDetail.cancelSettled: Money already received covers the cancellation fee, so no cancellation invoice was issued.
orderDetail.cancelInvoiceIssued: Cancellation invoice {number} issued for the remaining {amount}.
orderDetail.awaitingDpAssign: A driver can be assigned once the customer pays the DP. Create a Down Payment (DP) invoice, then mark it paid with the transfer proof. Days served by a partner can still be set.
orderDetail.notPaidForTrip: Order not paid in full ({left} of the rental left). The driver can still depart and mark the arrival at pickup, but "Start trip" in the app unlocks only once the settlement is recorded (invoice marked paid).

etoll.whenHint: Leave empty if it was just now.
etoll.giveTitle: Hand the card to a driver
etoll.giveOtherHint: This card is recorded with {name}. Handing it to another driver releases it from {name}.
etoll.returnIntro: Is the card from {name} back at the office?
etoll.deactivateIntro: Drivers can no longer take the card. If a driver holds it, it is released from them and a waiting top-up request is cancelled. The history stays.
etoll.deleteConfirm: Delete card {name}? Only a card without history can be deleted (e.g. a typo).

priceList.title: Price List
priceList.desc: The official Arasya price list. Change prices here, then press "Publish to website" so the new prices show on the website. Prices that are not published are not visible to visitors.
priceList.neverPublishedHint: The website keeps its old prices until this list is published.
priceList.firstPublish: This is the first publication: the whole list will appear on the website.
priceList.unpublished: {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}} not published yet
priceList.publishIntro: The website will be rebuilt with the prices in this list. The new prices show on the website once that is done.
priceList.publishNoChanges: No changes since the last publication.
priceList.okPublished: Prices published. The website is being updated.
priceList.okPublishedSkipped: Prices published, but the website is not set up to rebuild automatically. The new prices do not show on the website yet.
priceList.okPublishedFailed: The prices are saved and published, but the website rebuild did not start. Contact the developer to rebuild the website.
priceList.proposalHint: Proposed by the team, needs owner confirmation
priceList.quoteHint: This city has no price table. Prices are agreed per trip.
priceList.alsoUsedBy: This table is also used by: {cities}
priceList.surchargeTitle: Surcharge when a {city} rental is extended to these areas
priceList.mappingHint: Choose the price tables shown on this city page on the website, or mark it as a quote per trip.
priceList.usedByWarning: This table is used by several cities: {cities}. A price change applies to all of them.
priceList.gridHint: Leave a price empty for "Ask admin". Tick "proposed" when the owner has not confirmed the price yet.
priceList.unsavedCells: {count, plural, one {# cell changed} other {# cells changed}}, not saved yet
priceList.surchargesHint: Extra charge when a rental is extended to a given area. On the city pages only the Jakarta, Bandung, and Surabaya tables show them.
priceList.deleteAreaBody: The area {area} (+{amount}) will be removed from this table.
priceList.deleteAreaHint: The change history keeps the previous value.
priceList.carsDesc: The fleet shown on the website. Every car has a price row in every table. The order sets how cars are arranged in the tables and on the website.
priceList.slugHint: Must match the car slug on the website exactly, so the website can show its prices. Example: toyota-avanza.
priceList.priceClassHint: Published to the website with the price list, e.g. "Avanza sekelas". Cars of the same class usually cost the same.
priceList.newCarHint: A new car gets empty prices ("Ask admin", marked as proposed) in every table until its prices are filled in.
priceList.errOrder: Order must be a whole number from 0 to 10,000
priceList.errSlug: Slug may only contain lowercase letters, numbers, and -, e.g. toyota-avanza
priceList.extrasDesc: Driver costs and overtime. Overtime is calculated from the Fullday price of the same package, city, and car.
priceList.publishBlockedUnsaved: There are unsaved changes. Save or discard them before publishing.
priceList.publishProposals: {count, plural, one {# price is} other {# prices are}} still a proposal (not confirmed by the owner). If you publish, {count, plural, one {it appears} other {they appear}} on the website as official, without any proposal mark.
priceList.publishProposalsConfirm: I understand that {count, plural, one {this proposed price} other {these # proposed prices}} will appear on the website as official
priceList.leaveUnsaved: There are unsaved price changes. Leave this page anyway? They will be lost.
priceList.zoneTextsHint: The table name, "included", "not included" and the note are published to the website.
priceList.errMappingTables: Choose both tables, or tick priced per trip.
priceList.switchZoneUnsaved: This table's texts are not saved and will be lost if you switch tables. Switch anyway?
priceList.switchCityUnsaved: This city's table settings are not saved and will be lost if you switch cities. Switch anyway?
priceList.conflictSurchargeReloaded: Another admin just changed this area; its latest data is loaded: {area} +{amount}. Your entries are not saved. Check them, then click Save if you still want to replace it.
priceList.conflictCarReloaded: Another admin just changed this car; its latest data is loaded. Your entries are not saved. Check them, then click Save if you still want to replace it.
priceList.okPublishResent: These prices had already been published by the earlier attempt (its answer did not arrive), so they were not published twice. If there are still unpublished changes, click Publish again.
priceList.amountEmptyHint: Leave empty when there is no fixed cost; it then shows as "Ask admin" ("Tanya admin" on the website).

filePreview.imageHint: Tap or click the image to zoom
filePreview.loadFailed: This file cannot be shown here.
filePreview.pdfNotSupported: This browser cannot show a PDF inside the page. Open it in a new tab to view it.

maps.pointHint: Map point the customer picked on the website. Editing the address removes the point so the address and the point never disagree.
